
<div id="bvn-demo" class="bvn-layout">

<div class="bvn-panel">

<label class="bvn-control">
<span>μ₁</span>
<input
  data-param="mu1"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="mu1"></span>
</label>

<label class="bvn-control">
<span>μ₂</span>
<input
  data-param="mu2"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="mu2"></span>
</label>

<label class="bvn-control">
<span>σ₁</span>
<input
  data-param="sigma1"
  type="range"
  min="0.4"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="sigma1"></span>
</label>

<label class="bvn-control">
<span>σ₂</span>
<input
  data-param="sigma2"
  type="range"
  min="0.4"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="sigma2"></span>
</label>

<label class="bvn-control">
<span>ρ</span>
<input
  data-param="rho"
  type="range"
  min="-0.95"
  max="0.95"
  step="0.05"
  value="0">
<span data-value="rho"></span>
</label>

</div>

<div class="bvn-plot">
<svg></svg>
</div>

</div>

<script>
bivariateNormalDemo("#bvn-demo", {
  xmin: -5,
  xmax: 5,
  ymin: -5,
  ymax: 5,
  nPoints: 250
});
</script>
